caption: The drawing depicts a metallic object composed of a circular band with a clasp and three upward-curving arms, each arm terminating in a spherical bell. The band and arms are rendered in a brownish-grey metallic color, suggesting a material like iron or steel, with subtle shading to indicate texture and reflection. The spherical bells attached at the ends of each arm are a yellowish-gold color, featuring a small finial or loop at the top and a horizontal groove around their middle. The object is presented twice in the drawing: a larger, more detailed view at the upper center, showing the side and front, and a smaller, less detailed perspective view at the bottom right, showing the circular arrangement and three projecting arms. The background is a plain off-white, and there is minimal text or marking on the image, aside from a small label or signature to the left of the lower depiction and faint pencil arrows pointing at the object.
